name: VoxGRAF
definition: A 3D-aware GAN that generates radiance fields on a sparse voxel grid using a 3D CNN instead of a coordinate-based MLP, allowing for efficient rendering via alpha composition.
summary: VoxGRAF is a 3D-aware GAN that replaces MLPs with a sparse voxel grid generator to enable fast, 3D-consistent image synthesis via a single forward pass.
